title: SvgFilter
responsibility: Renders the native filter element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFilter.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet rendered as child markup when truthy; it is invoked with no arguments, and absent or falsy children render nothing.

outputs.name: SvgFilter
outputs.description: Produces one native SVG <filter> element, forwards every remaining prop as an attribute, and renders truthy children inside it; it adds no wrapper.
